label: Copy-phase reset unit for long sequences (L>=8, from the 3rd output on), weighted toward input tokens j/2/n
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase: never on original-token steps, never on the <DEL> step, and almost never at recall_idx 0-1. Rate rises steeply with sequence length (L<=5: none; L=9: 66% of mass) and is highest at recall_idx 2-4 and on the last outputs of L=9 sequences (t=16-17). Inside that positional window the input token modulates firing: j is the strongest (4.6x lift, 22% of mass), then 2 and n, then r/o/t/k/h/c. Position alone (copy, L>=8, recall_idx>=2) covers 88% of mass but only 25% precision. Adding the token set lifts dev F1 to about 0.49 (mass recall 0.62). The token dependence is graded and spread across many tokens rather than a clean set, so a lot is left unexplained. Activations are small (max 0.026). Top activations are mostly j inputs late in L=9 copies.
